payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes f(3)=2*max_i( max(max_x-xi,xi-min_x) + max(max_y-yi,yi-min_y) ) and f(k)=2*(max_x-min_x+max_y-min_y) for k>=4, using global extremes.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a direct formula derived from convex geometry and Manhattan distance, not DP. However, among given candidates, dp_2d_state is chosen as it vaguely relates to 2D state (x and y extents).
